description_en: Retrieves a list of available smart voices, including their names, genders, and sample audio. The voices are grouped by scenario
description_zh: 列出智能语音发音人信息，包括发音人名称、性别、示例音频，列表按照场景进行分组
name: ListSmartVoiceGroups

parameters.help_en: The voice type. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns voices from the small model by default. Set this parameter to `CosyVoice` to retrieve voices from the Cosyvoice large model
parameters.help_zh:
音色类型，默认不填时：返回小模型语种音色。支持传入：
Cosyvoice，返回Cosyvoice大模型音色示例
parameters.name: voice_type
